summary.request: General journal lines, sales lines and purchase lines get a Project Ref. When a line uses an allocation account, every allocated line must keep the Project Ref., and recurring journal allocations must also post it from the recurring line. When we send an intercompany sales order to a partner company in the same database, the partner's purchase order header and lines must get the Project Ref.
summary.business-process: General journal posting with Allocation Accounts and recurring allocations, sales and purchase document posting with Allocation Accounts, and intercompany sales order to partner purchase order (same database)

guards: Copy from the source line parameter; do not rely on TransferFields, which Validate("No.") clears

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification explicitly on every Project Ref. field in every table extension (a tableextension has no table-level value to inherit); choose the value that matches what the reference holds, such as CustomerContent for a business reference. Never leave ToBeClassified.
Add the two new subscriber codeunits to the app's Project Ref. permission set; name the page extensions in the plan.

tests.given: A general journal line with an Allocation Account with two allocation lines and a Project Ref. saved on the line, created with LibraryERM
tests.then: Every G/L entry created for the allocated lines carries the Project Ref.

tests.given: A sales invoice line with an Allocation Account and a Project Ref., created with LibrarySales
tests.then: Every posted Sales Invoice Line generated from the allocation carries the Project Ref.

tests.given: A purchase invoice line with an Allocation Account and a Project Ref., created with LibraryPurchase
tests.then: Every posted Purch. Inv. Line generated from the allocation carries the Project Ref.

tests.given: A recurring general journal line with Project Ref. and two Gen. Jnl. Allocation lines
tests.then: The recurring line's G/L entry and every allocation G/L entry carry the recurring line's Project Ref.

tests.given: A recurring journal line with a reversing recurring method, Project Ref. and allocations
tests.then: The reversing allocation G/L entries also carry the Project Ref.

tests.given: A posted journal transaction whose G/L entries carry Project Ref.
tests.then: The reversing G/L entries carry the same Project Ref.

tests.given: An IC partner with database inbox, a sales order to the IC customer with header and line Project Ref.
tests.when: The IC sales order is sent, moved to the partner and the partner creates the purchase order from the IC inbox
tests.then: The partner Purchase Header and every Purchase Line carry the same Project Ref. as the sending sales header and lines

tests.given: An IC inbox purchase line with Project Ref.
tests.when: The partner purchase line is created (TransferFields then Validate("No."))
tests.then: The purchase line still carries the Project Ref.

tests.given: An IC outbox sales header with Project Ref.
tests.when: The transaction is moved to the partner company in the same database
tests.then: The partner IC Inbox Purchase Header carries Project Ref. and the subscriber reads no setup of either company

tests.given: A sales order and a purchase order with header and line Project Ref.
tests.when: Each is shipped/received and invoiced, and archived
tests.then: Shipment, receipt, invoice headers and lines and the archive tables carry the same Project Ref.

knowledge.used-for: Allocation Account behavior for journals, sales and purchase lines
constraints: Journal: rely on TransferFields; the value must be saved on the source line because it is re-read by SystemId
Sales/purchase: copy the field in OnBeforeCreateSalesLine / OnBeforeCreatePurchaseLine, because Validate("No.") clears the TransferFields copy
Do not patch generated lines from OnAfterPostSalesDoc; they are already posted
Set a recurring-line value in OnPostAllocationsOnBeforeCopyFromGenJnlAlloc from AllocateGenJournalLine
Do not assume allocation postings inherit the recurring line; PostAllocations starts with Init()
A per-allocation value must be assigned on every call, including blanks, because the line variable is reused

knowledge.used-for: Intercompany sales document to partner purchase document
constraints: Add the field with the same number to the source document, IC outbox and IC inbox tables
Subscribe to the inbox insert events and to the purchase document modify events
Write code that works in either company; do not read the partner's setup in OnBeforeICInboxPurchHeaderInsert
Do not copy the line value in OnCreatePurchLinesOnAfterTransferFields
A file partner cannot carry the value

knowledge.used-for: Stage planning, page extensions, permission set and read-back tests
constraints: Plan one extension step per stage the field must reach
Name page extensions and permission set entries for new objects
Test by posting and reading the value back from every target
Do not fill ledger entries after posting by modifying them

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring Sales Header/Line fields on posted and archive tables
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on every TransferFields target unless the plan excludes a document type
No subscriber for these stages; keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring Purchase Header/Line fields on posted and archive tables
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on every TransferFields target unless the plan excludes a document type
No subscriber for these stages; keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables

knowledge.used-for: Field definition across the TransferFields cascade
constraints: Mirrored fields must have the same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of the new fields
constraints: Every Normal field in a tableextension must set its own DataClassification
Choose the value matching the stored data; ToBeClassified and SystemMetadata for customer data are under-classifications

knowledge.used-for: Sizing Project Ref. if it gets a TableRelation
constraints: Applies only if Project Ref. has a TableRelation
For an unconditional relation, use the exact type and length of the related field

knowledge.used-for: Carrying the journal value to G/L entries and reversal
constraints: A Gen. Journal Line field reaches G/L Entry only through OnAfterCopyGLEntryFromGenJnlLine
Decide per entry; VAT and bank entries only if their reports need it
State reversal behavior: a reference is copied unchanged; add a reversal test
Use a stored tableextension field on a hot ledger only when the value must appear as a native list column and is read on almost every access; otherwise use a related table keyed by Entry No.
Build fixtures with LibrarySales, LibraryPurchase, LibraryERM and LibraryRandom; create parents before dependents
Create the records the test owns; do not assume existing records
Fill every mandatory field; keep scenario-defining values explicit

open-questions.question: What is Project Ref.: free code, or a TableRelation to Job (Project) No. or another table? Its type and length must match the related field exactly for an unconditional relation, and the same definition is then used on every mirrored table.
How does the Sales Header Project Ref. get its value for an IC sales order (user entry, default from lines, or from somewhere else), and should a header value default to the lines?
The mirroring articles add Project Ref. to every posted and archive table. Can any document type (shipments, receipts, credit memos, return documents, archives) be excluded?
Must Project Ref. appear as a native column on G/L entries and be read on almost every access? If not, store it in a related table keyed by G/L Entry No. instead of a G/L Entry table extension.
Must Project Ref. also reach G/L entries from sales and purchase posting (via the Invoice Posting Buffer, including Group ID), customer/vendor ledger entries, or VAT and bank entries? Not designed.

Do users need Project Ref. on the handled IC tables (history)? Are file-based or API IC partners in scope? A file partner cannot carry the value, because xmlport IC Outbox Imp/Exp has a fixed field list.
Should Project Ref. flow back when a user copies a posted document (Copy Document uses TransferFields), or be cleared?
On which journal, document, posted-document and IC pages must Project Ref. be shown?
Which field number and object ID range does the app use? The field number must be identical on every table in this design.
